assertions.name: c2_gate
assertions.source: Does the operator s-series reproduce c_2 = -1? EXPECTED RED, and red is the result. The scalar u-reversion is singular, so the c_k are not scalar-q Taylor coefficients -- docs/audits/2026-06-16-hoefsmit-stage-b-attempt-verdict.md blocker 2. Do NOT relax this gate to make the witness green: it records a refutation, and the extracted quadratic is input-sensitive at ~7e5 amplification (see the data fields). ('proved c_2 = -1' until 2026-08-23: c_2 = -1 is STRUCTURAL, not proved -- N2_factor is a bare def with no theorem deriving it, per the AGENTS.md correction of 2026-08-16.)

description: Hoefsmit Stage B path-1: exact s=q-1 numeric series-match of the canonical operator ladder R=Q_beta/[Q_A cos(alpha_eff)] vs prod(1+c_k u^k), Q_beta=|Delta(net)|*E_0 from GB-reduced symbolic net. c_2=-1 gate; residual test for constant-c_k consistency.

data.why_c2_gate_is_red: NOT a defect and NOT a number to be fixed. The scalar u-reversion is singular (u is quadratic in q-1), so R(q) is not analytic in u and the c_k are not scalar-q Taylor coefficients. See docs/audits/2026-06-16-hoefsmit-stage-b-attempt-verdict.md blocker 2. Making this gate green would delete a recorded refutation.
data.extracted_quadratic_input_sensitivity: The 2026-06-16 witness carried -8.006410058709255, matching the registry's c_2^even = -1049/144 - 5*sqrt(3)/12 to 15 digits. The coincidence did NOT survive: a byte-identical producer now yields -7.45876032789888, because free-neutron-decay.witness.json was regenerated in 52c68267f2 (Delta(net) -0.18829060147138277 -> -0.1882906200111204). A 9.8e-8 relative input change moved the output 6.8% -- ~7e5 amplification, which is the audit's blocker-3 sigma(c_k) = sigma_R/u^k measured rather than argued. Do not identify the extracted quadratic with c_2, c_2-tilde or c_2^even.
